WITH RECURSIVE dates AS ( SELECT CAST( DATE_FORMAT( CURDATE() - INTERVAL 2 MONTH, '%Y-%m-01' ) AS DATE ) AS calendar_date
UNION ALL
SELECT calendar_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY FROM dates WHERE calendar_date < CURDATE() ),
daily_activity AS ( SELECT DATE(exam_at) AS study_date, COUNT(*) AS solved_count FROM member_quiz_history WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND answered = TRUE AND exam_at >= (SELECT MIN(calendar_date) FROM dates) AND exam_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY DATE(exam_at) )
SELECT dates.calendar_date AS date, CASE WHEN COALESCE(daily_activity.solved_count, 0) = 0 THEN 0 WHEN daily_activity.solved_count < 5 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS level FROM dates LEFT JOIN daily_activity ON daily_activity.study_date = dates.calendar_date ORDER BY dates.calendar_date
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(answered = TRUE), 0) AS done, COUNT(*) AS total FROM member_quiz_history WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND exam_at >= CURDATE() AND exam_at < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY
